rows.decision: General repository-linked sharing prose does not override granular registry access-only inheritance; resolve registry permission model before deriving visibility.
rows.verification: Observe package and repository visibility separately; missing package visibility stays unknown.

rows.decision: Classic PAT tutorial is scoped, not universal: eligible workflows use GITHUB_TOKEN and public Container Registry pulls may be anonymous.
rows.verification: Check task-specific credential and effective package rights without exposing tokens; no automatic token creation.

rows.decision: Pre-publication linked defaults, post-publication linking and org default disabling are distinct; org default does not prevent package overrides.
rows.verification: Observe actual inheritance and workflow grant; names/source labels alone cannot pass.

rows.decision: Switching inheritance overwrites permissions; workflow/fork and Codespaces audiences require separate before/after observations.
rows.verification: Approved plan/diff includes revoked and added access, denial tests and recovery; no grants applied in this tranche.

rows.decision: Public visibility is irreversible in the guide; namespace-occupant deletion is another destructive operation, not ordinary automatic rollback.
rows.verification: Do not promise private rollback; require exact publication approval and independently scoped destructive recovery approval.

rows.decision: Preserve greater-than-5000 public download restriction, 30-day window and namespace/version availability with scope-specific admins; GHES restore-role wording remains unresolved.
rows.verification: Threshold units and target IDs must match; missing counts/permissions/time are unknown, not allowed; GHES restoration adapter not certified.

rows.decision: Deployment/version/registry capabilities and identity namespaces remain separate. Internal can include enterprise-wide audience; GHES >=3.23 automatic Dependabot is not proof for 3.18-3.22.
rows.verification: Resolve feature predicates and effective target enablement; registry incompatibility is explicit capability gap, not objective exemption.

rows.decision: Metadata, instructions, UI absence and possible advisory alerts are not executable behavior, rights, deletion or remediation proof.
rows.verification: Require operation-specific positive/negative observations and exact-use rights evidence; source advice is not adopted policy.
